subject: Shiny widget error in RMarkdown ("Not Found") though works in Rstudio console

messages.author: 49f7189b2be38755
messages.subject: Shiny widget error in RMarkdown ("Not Found") though works in Rstudio console
parts:
I am trying to write a shiny widget to read a data file and then multiple widgets to display different views using tabpanels.  It works if I run it in Rstudio console.  However, it does not work if I run it in a Rmarkdown file.

The following is a simplified version of my code.

library(rmdexamples)
main <- function(){  
  shinyApp( 
    ui = fluidPage(
      sidebarLayout(
        sidebarPanel(fileInput(inputId = "datafile",label="Data file")),
        mainPanel(uiOutput("mainpanel"))
      )
    ),
    
    server = function(input, output) {  
      iris_2 = reactive(
        if (is.null(input$datafile)){
          NULL
        }else {
          read.csv(input$datafile$datapath)
        }
      )
      output$mainpanel <- renderUI({
        if(is.null(iris_2())){return ()
        } else {
          #df <- iris_2()
          df <- iris
          tabsetPanel(id = "mpanel", type = "pill"
                      ,tabPanel("Tab 1",renderPlot(hist(rnorm(100))))
                      ,tabPanel("Tab 2",kmeans_cluster(df))
                      )
        }   
      })
    }    
  )
}

In Rstudio console, main() works fine.

In a Rmd file, the "Tab 2" displays "Not Found" instead of the kmeans_cluster widget;  the "Tab 1" works in both console and Rmd file.

Any help would be greatly appreciated.

Peng
